recognize_zh: 抹片中大量中小型淋巴細胞，核圓或略不規則、染色質中度凝集，細胞質少而偏嗜鹼性並有小突起（blebs），混雜少數顆粒球系細胞；這種以成熟外觀、帶細胞質突起的淋巴細胞為主的族群，符合 T 前淋巴球性白血病（T-PLL）侵犯。
features: Predominant population of small to intermediate lymphoid cells
High N:C ratio with scant, deeply basophilic cytoplasm showing small cytoplasmic protrusions/blebs
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin; nucleoli not prominent at this resolution
Admixed band neutrophils, a granulated precursor and an eosinophilic myelocyte
One larger cell with abundant granular cytoplasm (likely a promyelocyte)
describe_en: Smear (bone marrow aspirate appearance given admixed granulocytic precursors) shows a predominant population of small to intermediate lymphoid cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, round to mildly irregular nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm with small cytoplasmic blebs. Residual granulocytic elements, including bands, an eosinophilic myelocyte and a probable promyelocyte, are present. Nucleoli are not well resolved at this magnification. Findings are consistent with involvement by T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia; confirmation requires flow cytometry (CD3+, CD7 strong, CD4+ or CD4/CD8 co-expression) and TCL1A rearrangement studies.

ddx.vs: CLL cells have soccer-ball clumped chromatin without cytoplasmic blebs and are CD5+/CD23+/CD200+ B cells rather than TCL1-positive T cells.
Sezary cells have cerebriform, deeply grooved nuclei and are CD4+/CD7-negative, whereas T-PLL cells have round nuclei with blebs and strong CD7.
ATLL shows polylobated 'flower' nuclei, CD25 expression and HTLV-1 serology positivity.

ddx.dx: B-cell prolymphocytic leukemia (now B-PLL/splenic B-cell lymphoma)
ddx.vs: B-prolymphocytes have a single prominent central nucleolus and more cytoplasm, and express B-cell antigens.
